api_version.description: Current API version supported by the server

oneOf.description: macOS background auto-start (LaunchAgent) state; `None` on non-macOS.

configured.description:
The LaunchAgent plist exists — the single source of truth for the macOS
`auto_start` flag.

loaded.description:
launchd currently has the agent loaded in this GUI session. `false` right
after enabling is normal: it takes effect at the next login/restart.

path_valid.description: The executable the plist points at still exists on disk.

default_install_path.description: Default installation directory proposed to the user when installing the service.

initialized.description: Indicates whether the system is initialized (e.g., admin password set)

is_admin.description: Whether the current process has admin/root privileges

oneOf.description: macOS TCC permission grants; `None` on non-macOS.

server_binary_available.description:
Whether the server binary is available for service installation.
True when lcxl-remote-desk-server(.exe) exists alongside the current
executable (both binaries share the same target directory in dev and
the same install directory in production).

service_installed.description: Whether the OS system service (LcxlDeskService) is installed

startup_mode.description:
Startup mode of the server. Typed rather than free-form so the generated
client gets the exact set of mode names to compare against.
